notes:
- **Beautiful seasonal themes**: during Christmas, Halloween, Black Friday and other seasons the app gets matching colours, a pixel-art badge in the title bar, a gently animated decoration (Christmas lights, bunting, icicles...) and a seasonal pointer - over buttons it becomes the season's pixel art, like a Christmas tree. Turn the effects off any time in Settings > Appearance.
- **Token gifts**: when MyCraftingAI gives you extra tokens, the app tells you right away what you received and until when.
- **Clearer offers**: running promotions show the best discount per plan in the title bar and in upgrade prompts.
